```{r, warning=F}

# 1. Parse timestamps safely
cutoff   <- as.POSIXct("2025-07-01 00:00:00", tz = "UTC")
end_date <- as.POSIXct("2026-07-31 23:59:59", tz = "UTC")

df_filtered <- df %>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP_true = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(TIMESTAMP_true >= cutoff & TIMESTAMP_true <= end_date)

# Common styling variables
lbl_y_temp <- expression("Temperature ("*degree*C*")")
lbl_y_vwc  <- expression("Soil Moisture VWC (m"^3*"/m"^3*")")
color_map  <- c(
  "Center" = "black", 
  "East"   = "firebrick", 
  "West"   = "dodgerblue4", 
  "North"  = "forestgreen", 
  "South"  = "gold3"
)

# =========================================================================
# PLOT 1: +15cm Air Temperature Horizon
# =========================================================================
# Filter out rows where all loggers are NA for this specific depth
df_p1 <- df_filtered %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TMS_C_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_E_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_W_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_N_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_S_T_1))

p1 <- ggplot(df_p1, aes(x = TIMESTAMP_true)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = TMS_C_T_1, color = "Center"), linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TMS_E_T_1, color = "East"),   linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TMS_W_T_1, color = "West"),   linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TMS_N_T_1, color = "North"),  linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TMS_S_T_1, color = "South"),  linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map, name = "Logger Station") +
  scale_x_datetime(limits = c(cutoff, end_date), date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(x = "Timeline", y = lbl_y_temp, title = "TMS Network Profile Comparison: +15cm Air Horizon") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p1)

# =========================================================================
# PLOT 2: 0cm Ground Surface Temperature Horizon
# =========================================================================
```

#remove zeros
```{r}

# ============================================================
# TMS NORTH VWC - REMOVE ZERO READINGS ONLY
# ============================================================

df_clean_N <- as.data.table(copy(df_filtered))
setorder(df_clean_N, TIMESTAMP_true)

# Preserve original and create cleaned column
df_clean_N[, TMS_N_VWC.c := TMS_N_VWC]

# Replace exact zeros with NA
df_clean_N[TMS_N_VWC == 0, TMS_N_VWC.c := NA_real_]

# Cleaning summary
cat("Original:", sum(!is.na(df_clean_N$TMS_N_VWC)), "\n")
cat("Zero readings:", sum(df_clean_N$TMS_N_VWC == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Removed:", sum(!is.na(df_clean_N$TMS_N_VWC) & is.na(df_clean_N$TMS_N_VWC.c)), "\n")
cat("Remaining:", sum(!is.na(df_clean_N$TMS_N_VWC.c)), "\n")

```

#add .c to variables
```{r}

setDT(df)

# Create cleaned columns directly in df
df[, TMS_N_VWC.c := TMS_N_VWC]
df[, TMS_S_VWC.c := TMS_S_VWC]

# Remove exact zero readings in the cleaned columns
df[TMS_N_VWC == 0, TMS_N_VWC.c := NA_real_]
df[TMS_S_VWC == 0, TMS_S_VWC.c := NA_real_]

# All temperature columns
tms_temp <- c(
  paste0("TMS_", c("C", "E", "W", "N", "S"), "_T_", 1:3)
)

# Copy original temperatures into .c columns
for (v in tms_temp) {
  df[, paste0(v, ".c") := get(v)]
}

# Other VWC columns (unchanged)
for (v in c("TMS_C_VWC", "TMS_E_VWC", "TMS_W_VWC")) {
  df[, paste0(v, ".c") := get(v)]
}

# Verify
grep("\\.c$", names(df), value = TRUE)


```
